settings.journalDurability.fast.hint: Records reach the OS cache before each file operation. Survives an app crash; after a power loss or OS crash the last few records may be lost, so Undo/Recovery may not know about a very recent move.
settings.journalDurability.safe.hint: Every record is forced to disk before the file operation starts. Safest, but about 4x slower per record (still off the UI thread, so the app stays responsive).
